name: WriteToCsvFile
label: Write to CSV File
description: Writes a data table, data row, or list to a CSV file.

fields.name: VariableToWrite
fields.label: Variable to Write
fields.description: The data to write to the CSV file (DataTable, DataRow, or List).

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the CSV file to write.

fields.name: EncodingOption
fields.label: Encoding
fields.description: The encoding of the CSV file.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8
selectOptions.description: UTF-8 encoding with byte order mark.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8 (no byte order mark)
selectOptions.description: UTF-8 encoding without byte order mark.

fields.name: UseCustomColumnSeparator
fields.label: Use Custom Column Separator
fields.description: Specifies whether to use a custom column separator.

fields.name: CustomColumnSeparator
fields.label: Custom Column Separator
fields.description: The custom delimiter used in the CSV file.

fields.name: PredefinedSeparator
fields.label: Predefined Separator
fields.description: The predefined separator used in the CSV file (e.g., Comma, Tab).

selectOptions.label: System Default
selectOptions.description: Uses a System Default as the separator.

selectOptions.label: Comma
selectOptions.description: Uses a comma (,) as the separator.

selectOptions.label: Tab
selectOptions.description: Uses a tab character as the separator.

selectOptions.label: Semicolon
selectOptions.description: Uses a semicolon (;) as the separator.

fields.name: IfFileExists
fields.label: If File Exists
fields.description: Specifies how to handle existing files.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite Existing Content
selectOptions.description: Overwrites the existing content of the file.

selectOptions.label: Append Content
selectOptions.description: Appends content to the end of the existing file.
